question: What containment sequence should the incident commander approve?
context: Response policy I5 requires an actively exfiltrating host to be isolated within 15 minutes. Forensic evidence must be preserved first when a memory capture can finish without missing that containment deadline.

evidence.text: Network monitoring detected active exfiltration from the host six minutes ago.
A memory capture takes five minutes; isolating the host takes two minutes after the capture.
Powering the host off immediately would destroy the in-memory encryption keys needed for the investigation.

fields.name: containment_in
fields.description: minutes from detection until isolation completes

fields.name: memory_preserved
fields.description: is volatile memory captured before isolation

fields.name: host_power
fields.description: host power state during the sequence
